newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu ends little changed vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu ends little changed vs dlr.

text.p: 1430 GMT - Romania's leu closed slightly lower at about 7,190/250 to the dollar from 7,180/250 in early trading on a fairly liquid interbank market, traders said.
* Operators said hard currency supply stayed high with the central bank (BNR) continuing to purchase dollars to prevent the leu from firming. They said the BNR bid was near 7,200 lei.
* Short-term rates marked time at about 46 percent with the money market using T-bill yields at Tuesday's auction as a benchmark for its prices.
* On Tuesday, the three-month T-bills yield fell to 46 percent from a previous 49 amid a heavy oversubscription with banks' bids ranging from 40 to 60 percent.
* Leu-dollar retail prices inched down to about 7,040/100 from some 7,000/100 in the past few days.
